arabic: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
transliteration: Saaad; wal-Qur-aani ziz zikr

translations.en.sahih: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder...
translations.en.pickthall: Sad. By the renowned Qur'an,
translations.en.yusufali: Sad: By the Qur'an, Full of Admonition: (This is the Truth).
translations.id.indonesian: Shaad, demi Al Quran yang mempunyai keagungan.

arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
transliteration: Balil lazeena kafaroo fee 'izzatilnw wa shiqaaq

translations.en.sahih: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve are in false pride and schism.
translations.en.yusufali: But the Unbelievers (are steeped) in self-glory and Separatism.
translations.id.indonesian: Sebenarnya orang-orang kafir itu (berada) dalam kesombongan dan permusuhan yang sengit.

arabic: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
transliteration: Kam ahlaknaa min qablihim min qarnin fanaadaw wa laata heena manaas

translations.en.sahih: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
translations.en.pickthall: How many a generation We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was no longer the time for escape!
translations.en.yusufali: How many generations before them did We destroy? In the end they cried (for mercy)- when there was no longer time for being saved!
translations.id.indonesian: Betapa banyaknya umat sebelum mereka yang telah Kami binasakan, lalu mereka meminta tolong padahal (waktu itu) bukanlah saat untuk lari melepaskan diri.

arabic: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
transliteration: Wa 'ajibooo an jaaa'a hum munzirum minhum wa qaalal kaafiroona haazaa saahirun kazzaab

translations.en.sahih: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.
translations.en.pickthall: And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come unto them, and the disbelievers say: This is a wizard, a charlatan.
translations.en.yusufali: So they wonder that a Warner has come to them from among themselves! and the Unbelievers say, "This is a sorcerer telling lies!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka heran karena mereka kedatangan seorang pemberi peringatan (rasul) dari kalangan mereka; dan orang-orang kafir berkata: "Ini adalah seorang ahli sihir yang banyak berdusta".

arabic: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
transliteration: Aja'alal aalihata Ilaahanw Waahidan inna haazaa lashai'un 'ujaab

translations.en.sahih: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."
translations.en.pickthall: Maketh he the gods One Allah? Lo! that is an astounding thing.
translations.en.yusufali: "Has he made the gods (all) into one Allah? Truly this is a wonderful thing!"
translations.id.indonesian: Mengapa ia menjadikan tuhan-tuhan itu Tuhan Yang Satu saja? Sesungguhnya ini benar-benar suatu hal yang sangat mengherankan.

arabic: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
transliteration: Wantalaqal mala-u minhum anim shoo wasbiroo 'alaaa aalihatikum innna haazaa lashai 'uny yuraad

translations.en.sahih: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.
translations.en.pickthall: The chiefs among them go about, exhorting: Go and be staunch to your gods! Lo! this is a thing designed.
translations.en.yusufali: And the leader among them go away (impatiently), (saying), "Walk ye away, and remain constant to your gods! For this is truly a thing designed (against you)!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan pergilah pemimpin-pemimpin mereka (seraya berkata): "Pergilah kamu dan tetaplah (menyembah) tuhan-tuhanmu, sesungguhnya ini benar-benar suatu hal yang dikehendaki.

arabic: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ
transliteration: Maa sami'naa bihaazaa fil millatil aakhirati in haazaaa illakh tilaaq

translations.en.sahih: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.
translations.en.pickthall: We have not heard of this in later religion. This is naught but an invention.
translations.en.yusufali: "We never heard (the like) of this among the people of these latter days: this is nothing but a made-up tale!"
translations.id.indonesian: Kami tidak pernah mendengar hal ini dalam agama yang terakhir; ini (mengesakan Allah), tidak lain hanyalah (dusta) yang diada-adakan,

arabic: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
transliteration: 'A-unzila 'alaihiz zikru mim baininaa; bal hum fee shakkim min Zikree bal lammaa yazooqoo 'azaab

translations.en.sahih: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
translations.en.pickthall: Hath the reminder been unto him (alone) among us? Nay, but they are in doubt concerning My reminder; nay but they have not yet tasted My doom.
translations.en.yusufali: "What! has the Message been sent to him - (Of all persons) among us?"... but they are in doubt concerning My (Own) Message! Nay, they have not yet tasted My Punishment!
translations.id.indonesian: mengapa Al Quran itu diturunkan kepadanya di antara kita?" Sebenarnya mereka ragu-ragu terhadap Al Quran-Ku, dan sebenarnya mereka belum merasakan azab-Ku.

arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
transliteration: Am'indahum khazaaa 'inu rahmati Rabbikal 'Azeezil Wahhab

translations.en.sahih: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?
translations.en.pickthall: Or are theirs the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower?
translations.en.yusufali: Or have they the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord,- the Exalted in Power, the Grantor of Bounties without measure?
translations.id.indonesian: Atau apakah mereka itu mempunyai perbendaharaan rahmat Tuhanmu Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Pemberi?

arabic: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ
transliteration: Am lahum mulkus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa falyartaqoo fil asbaab

translations.en.sahih: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.
translations.en.pickthall: Or is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them theirs? Then let them ascend by ropes!
translations.en.yusufali: Or have they the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all between? If so, let them mount up with the ropes and means (to reach that end)!
translations.id.indonesian: Atau apakah bagi mereka kerajaan langit dan bumi dan yang ada di antara keduanya? (Jika ada), maka hendaklah mereka menaiki tangga-tangga (ke langit).

arabic: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
transliteration: Jundum maa hunaalika mahzoomum minal Ahzaab

translations.en.sahih: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
translations.en.pickthall: A defeated host are (all) the factions that are there.
translations.en.yusufali: But there - will be put to flight even a host of confederates.
translations.id.indonesian: Suatu tentara yang besar yang berada disana dari golongan-golongan yang berserikat, pasti akan dikalahkan.

arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
transliteration: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Lootinw-wa 'Aadunw wa Fir'awnu zul awtaad

translations.en.sahih: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,
translations.en.pickthall: The folk of Noah before them denied (their messenger) and (so did the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh firmly planted,
translations.en.yusufali: Before them (were many who) rejected messengers,- the people of Noah, and 'Ad, and Pharaoh, the Lord of Stakes,
translations.id.indonesian: Telah mendustakan (rasul-rasul pula) sebelum mereka itu kaum Nuh, 'Aad, Fir'aun yang mempunyai tentara yang banyak,

arabic: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
transliteration: Wa Samoodu wa qawmu Lootinw wa Ashaabul 'Aykah; ulaaa'ikal Ahzaab

translations.en.sahih: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies.
translations.en.pickthall: And (the tribe of) Thamud, and the folk of Lot, and the dwellers in the wood: these were the factions.
translations.en.yusufali: And Thamud, and the people of Lut, and the Companions of the Wood; - such were the Confederates.
translations.id.indonesian: dan Tsamud, kaum Luth dan penduduk Aikah. Mereka itulah golongan-golongan yang bersekutu (menentang rasul-rasul).

arabic: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
transliteration: In kullun illaa kazzabar Rusula fahaqqa 'iqaab

translations.en.sahih: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
translations.en.pickthall: Not one of them but did deny the messengers, therefor My doom was justified,
translations.en.yusufali: Not one (of them) but rejected the messengers, but My punishment came justly and inevitably (on them).
translations.id.indonesian: Semua mereka itu tidak lain hanyalah mendustakan rasul-rasul, maka pastilah (bagi mereka) azab-Ku.

arabic: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
transliteration: Wa maa yanzuru haaa ulaaa'i illaa saihatanw waahidatam maa lahaa min fawaaq

translations.en.sahih: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.
translations.en.pickthall: These wait for but one Shout, there will be no second thereto.
translations.en.yusufali: These (today) only wait for a single mighty Blast, which (when it comes) will brook no delay.
translations.id.indonesian: Tidaklah yang mereka tunggu melainkan hanya satu teriakan saja yang tidak ada baginya saat berselang.

arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
transliteration: Wa qaaloo Rabbanaa 'ajjil lanaa qittanaa qabla Yawmil Hisaab

translations.en.sahih: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account"
translations.en.pickthall: They say: Our Lord! Hasten on for us our fate before the Day of Reckoning.
translations.en.yusufali: They say: "Our Lord! hasten to us our sentence (even) before the Day of Account!"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka berkata: "Ya Tuhan kami cepatkanlah untuk kami azab yang diperuntukkan bagi kami sebelum hari berhisab".

arabic: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
transliteration: Isbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wazkur 'abdanaa Daawooda zal aidi aidi innahooo awwaab

translations.en.sahih: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah].
translations.en.pickthall: Bear with what they say, and remember Our bondman David, lord of might, Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah).
translations.en.yusufali: Have patience at what they say, and remember our servant David, the man of strength: for he ever turned (to Allah).
translations.id.indonesian: Bersabarlah atas segala apa yang mereka katakan; dan ingatlah hamba Kami Daud yang mempunyai kekuatan; sesungguhnya dia amat taat (kepada Tuhan).

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
transliteration: Innaa sakhkharnal jibaala ma'ahoo yusabbihna bil'ashaiyi wal ishraaq

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We subdued the hills to hymn the praises (of their Lord) with him at nightfall and sunrise,
translations.en.yusufali: It was We that made the hills declare, in unison with him, Our Praises, at eventide and at break of day,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami menundukkan gunung-gunung untuk bertasbih bersama dia (Daud) di waktu petang dan pagi,

arabic: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
transliteration: Wattayra mahshoorah; kullul lahooo awwaab

translations.en.sahih: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
translations.en.pickthall: And the birds assembled; all were turning unto Him.
translations.en.yusufali: And the birds gathered (in assemblies): all with him did turn (to Allah).
translations.id.indonesian: dan (Kami tundukkan pula) burung-burung dalam keadaan terkumpul. Masing-masingnya amat taat kepada Allah.

arabic: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
transliteration: Wa shadadnaa mulkahoo wa aatainaahul Hikmata wa faslal khitaab

translations.en.sahih: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
translations.en.pickthall: We made his kingdom strong and gave him wisdom and decisive speech.
translations.en.yusufali: We strengthened his kingdom, and gave him wisdom and sound judgment in speech and decision.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami kuatkan kerajaannya dan Kami berikan kepadanya hikmahdan kebijaksanaan dalam menyelesaikan perselisihan.

arabic: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ
transliteration: Wa hal ataaka naba'ul khasm; iz tasawwarul mihraab

translations.en.sahih: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
translations.en.pickthall: And hath the story of the litigants come unto thee? How they climbed the wall into the royal chamber;
translations.en.yusufali: Has the Story of the Disputants reached thee? Behold, they climbed over the wall of the private chamber;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan adakah sampai kepadamu berita orang-orang yang berperkara ketika mereka memanjat pagar?

arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
transliteration: Iz dakhaloo 'alaa Daawooda fafazi'a minhum qaaloo la takhaf khasmaani baghaa ba'dunaa 'alaa ba'din fahkum bainanaaa bilhaqqi wa laa tushtit wahdinaaa ilaa Sawaaa'is Siraat

translations.en.sahih: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
translations.en.pickthall: How they burst in upon David, and he was afraid of them. They said: Be not afraid! (We are) two litigants, one of whom hath wronged the other, therefor judge aright between us; be not unjust; and show us the fair way.
translations.en.yusufali: When they entered the presence of David, and he was terrified of them, they said: "Fear not: we are two disputants, one of whom has wronged the other: Decide now between us with truth, and treat us not with injustice, but guide us to the even Path..
translations.id.indonesian: Ketika mereka masuk (menemui) Daud lalu ia terkejut karena kedatangan) mereka. Mereka berkata: "Janganlah kamu merasa takut; (kami) adalah dua orang yang berperkara yang salah seorang dari kami berbuat zalim kepada yang lain; maka berilah keputusan antara kami dengan adil dan janganlah kamu menyimpang dari kebenaran dan tunjukilah kami ke jalan yang lurus.

arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ
transliteration: Inna haazaaa akhee lahoo tis'unw wa tis'oona na'jatanw wa liya na'jatunw waahidah; faqaala akfilneeha wa 'azzanee filkhitaab

translations.en.sahih: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! this my brother hath ninety and nine ewes while I had one ewe; and he said: Entrust it to me, and he conquered me in speech.
translations.en.yusufali: "This man is my brother: He has nine and ninety ewes, and I have (but) one: Yet he says, 'commit her to my care,' and is (moreover) harsh to me in speech."
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya saudaraku ini mempunyai sembilan puluh sembilan ekor kambing betina dan aku mempunyai seekor saja. Maka dia berkata: "Serahkanlah kambingmu itu kepadaku dan dia mengalahkan aku dalam perdebatan".

arabic: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّـٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ ۩
transliteration: Qaala laqad zalamaka bisu 'aali na'jatika ilaa ni'aajihee wa inna kaseeram minal khulataaa'i la-yabghee ba'duhum 'alaa ba'din illal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati wa qaleehum maa hum; wa zanna Daawoodu annamaa fatannaahu fastaghrara Rabbahoo wa kharra raaki'anw wa anaab

translations.en.sahih: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah].
translations.en.pickthall: (David) said: He hath wronged thee in demanding thine ewe in addition to his ewes, and lo! many partners oppress one another, save such as believe and do good works, and they are few. And David guessed that We had tried him, and he sought forgiveness of his Lord, and he bowed himself and fell down prostrate and repented.
translations.en.yusufali: (David) said: "He has undoubtedly wronged thee in demanding thy (single) ewe to be added to his (flock of) ewes: truly many are the partners (in business) who wrong each other: Not so do those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, and how few are they?"... and David gathered that We had tried him: he asked forgiveness of his Lord, fell down, bowing (in prostration), and turned (to Allah in repentance).
translations.id.indonesian: Daud berkata: "Sesungguhnya dia telah berbuat zalim kepadamu dengan meminta kambingmu itu untuk ditambahkan kepada kambingnya. Dan sesungguhnya kebanyakan dari orang-orang yang berserikat itu sebahagian mereka berbuat zalim kepada sebahagian yang lain, kecuali orang-orang yang beriman dan mengerjakan amal yang saleh; dan amat sedikitlah mereka ini". Dan Daud mengetahui bahwa Kami mengujinya; maka ia meminta ampun kepada Tuhannya lalu menyungkur sujud dan bertaubat.

arabic: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
transliteration: Faghafarnaa lahoo zaalik; wa inna lahoo 'indanaa lazulfaa wa husna ma aab

translations.en.sahih: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
translations.en.pickthall: So We forgave him that; and lo! he had access to Our presence and a happy journey's end.
translations.en.yusufali: So We forgave him this (lapse): he enjoyed, indeed, a Near Approach to Us, and a beautiful place of (Final) Return.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Kami ampuni baginya kesalahannya itu. Dan sesungguhnya dia mempunyai kedudukan dekat pada sisi Kami dan tempat kembali yang baik.

arabic: يَـٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰكَ خَلِيفَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
transliteration: Yaa Daawoodu innaa ja'alnaaka khaleefatan fil ardi fahkum bainan naasi bilhaqqi wa laa tattabi'il hawaa fayudillaka 'an sabeelil laah; innal lazeena yadilloona 'an sabeelil laah; lahum 'azaabun shadeedum bimaa nasoo Yawmal Hisaab

translations.en.sahih: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
translations.en.pickthall: (And it was said unto him): O David! Lo! We have set thee as a viceroy in the earth; therefor judge aright between mankind, and follow not desire that it beguile thee from the way of Allah. Lo! those who wander from the way of Allah have an awful doom, forasmuch as they forgot the Day of Reckoning.
translations.en.yusufali: O David! We did indeed make thee a vicegerent on earth: so judge thou between men in truth (and justice): Nor follow thou the lusts (of thy heart), for they will mislead thee from the Path of Allah: for those who wander astray from the Path of Allah, is a Penalty Grievous, for that they forget the Day of Account.
translations.id.indonesian: Hai Daud, sesungguhnya Kami menjadikan kamu khalifah (penguasa) di muka bumi, maka berilah keputusan (perkara) di antara manusia dengan adil dan janganlah kamu mengikuti hawa nafsu, karena ia akan menyesatkan kamu dari jalan Allah. Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang sesat darin jalan Allah akan mendapat azab yang berat, karena mereka melupakan hari perhitungan.

arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَـٰطِلًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
transliteration: Wa ma khalaqnas samaaa'a wal arda wa maa bainahumaa baatilaa; zaalika zannul lazeena kafaroo; fawi lul lillazeena kafaroo minan Naar

translations.en.sahih: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
translations.en.pickthall: And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in vain. That is the opinion of those who disbelieve. And woe unto those who disbelieve, from the Fire!
translations.en.yusufali: Not without purpose did We create heaven and earth and all between! that were the thought of Unbelievers! but woe to the Unbelievers because of the Fire (of Hell)!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami tidak menciptakan langit dan bumi dan apa yang ada antara keduanya tanpa hikmah. Yang demikian itu adalah anggapan orang-orang kafir, maka celakalah orang-orang kafir itu karena mereka akan masuk neraka.

arabic: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ
transliteration: Am naj'alul lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati kalmufisdeena fil ardi am naj'alul muttaqeena kalfujjaar

translations.en.sahih: Or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked?
translations.en.pickthall: Shall We treat those who believe and do good works as those who spread corruption in the earth; or shall We treat the pious as the wicked?
translations.en.yusufali: Shall We treat those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, the same as those who do mischief on earth? Shall We treat those who guard against evil, the same as those who turn aside from the right?
translations.id.indonesian: Patutkah Kami menganggap orang-orang yang beriman dan mengerjakan amal yang saleh sama dengan orang-orang yang berbuat kerusakan di muka bumi? Patutkah (pula) Kami menganggap orang-orang yang bertakwa sama dengan orang-orang yang berbuat maksiat?

arabic: كِتَـٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَـٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
transliteration: Kitaabun anzalnaahu ilaika mubaarakul liyaddabbarooo Aayaatihee wa liyatazakkara ulul albaab

translations.en.sahih: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
translations.en.pickthall: (This is) a Scripture that We have revealed unto thee, full of blessing, that they may ponder its revelations, and that men of understanding may reflect.
translations.en.yusufali: (Here is) a Book which We have sent down unto thee, full of blessings, that they may mediate on its Signs, and that men of understanding may receive admonition.
translations.id.indonesian: Ini adalah sebuah kitab yang Kami turunkan kepadamu penuh dengan berkah supaya mereka memperhatikan ayat-ayatnya dan supaya mendapat pelajaran orang-orang yang mempunyai fikiran.

arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
transliteration: Wa wahabnaa li Daawooda Sulaimaan; ni'mal 'abd; innahoo awwaab

translations.en.sahih: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].
translations.en.pickthall: And We bestowed on David, Solomon. How excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah).
translations.en.yusufali: To David We gave Solomon (for a son),- How excellent in Our service! Ever did he turn (to Us)!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami karuniakan kepada Daud, Sulaiman, dia adalah sebaik-baik hamba. Sesungguhnya dia amat taat (kepada Tuhannya),

arabic: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّـٰفِنَـٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
transliteration: Iz 'urida 'alaihi bil'ashiy yis saafinaatul jiyaad

translations.en.sahih: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
translations.en.pickthall: When there were shown to him at eventide lightfooted coursers
translations.en.yusufali: Behold, there were brought before him, at eventide coursers of the highest breeding, and swift of foot;
translations.id.indonesian: (ingatlah) ketika dipertunjukkan kepadanya kuda-kuda yang tenang di waktu berhenti dan cepat waktu berlari pada waktu sore,

arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
transliteration: Faqaala inneee ahbabtu hubbal khairi 'an zikri Rabbee hattaa tawaarat bilhijaab

translations.en.sahih: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
translations.en.pickthall: And he said: Lo! I have preferred the good things (of the world) to the remembrance of my Lord; till they were taken out of sight behind the curtain.
translations.en.yusufali: And he said, "Truly do I love the love of good, with a view to the glory of my Lord,"- until (the sun) was hidden in the veil (of night):
translations.id.indonesian: maka ia berkata: "Sesungguhnya aku menyukai kesenangan terhadap barang yang baik (kuda) sehingga aku lalai mengingat Tuhanku sampai kuda itu hilang dari pandangan".

arabic: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ
transliteration: Ruddoohaa 'alaiya fatafiqa masham bissooqi wal a'naaq

translations.en.sahih: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.
translations.en.pickthall: (Then he said): Bring them back to me, and fell to slashing (with his sword their) legs and necks.
translations.en.yusufali: "Bring them back to me." then began he to pass his hand over (their) legs and their necks.
translations.id.indonesian: "Bawalah kuda-kuda itu kembali kepadaku". Lalu ia potong kaki dan leher kuda itu.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
transliteration: Wa laqad fatannaa Sulaimaana wa alqainaa 'alaa kursiyyihee jasadan summa anaab

translations.en.sahih: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.
translations.en.pickthall: And verily We tried Solomon, and set upon his throne a (mere) body. Then did he repent.
translations.en.yusufali: And We did try Solomon: We placed on his throne a body (without life); but he did turn (to Us in true devotion):
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah menguji Sulaiman dan Kami jadikan (dia) tergeletak di atas kursinya sebagai tubuh (yang lemah karena sakit), kemudian ia bertaubat.

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
transliteration: Qaala Rabbigh fir lee wa hab lee mulkal laa yambaghee li ahadim mim ba'de inaka Antal Wahhab

translations.en.sahih: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Forgive me and bestow on me sovereignty such as shall not belong to any after me. Lo! Thou art the Bestower.
translations.en.yusufali: He said, "O my Lord! Forgive me, and grant me a kingdom which, (it may be), suits not another after me: for Thou art the Grantor of Bounties (without measure).
translations.id.indonesian: Ia berkata: "Ya Tuhanku, ampunilah aku dan anugerahkanlah kepadaku kerajaan yang tidak dimiliki oleh seorang juapun sesudahku, sesungguhnya Engkaulah Yang Maha Pemberi".

arabic: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
transliteration: Fasakhkharnaa lahur reeha tajree bi amrihee rukhaaa'an haisu asaab

translations.en.sahih: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
translations.en.pickthall: So We made the wind subservient unto him, setting fair by his command whithersoever he intended.
translations.en.yusufali: Then We subjected the wind to his power, to flow gently to his order, Whithersoever he willed,-
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian Kami tundukkan kepadanya angin yang berhembus dengan baik menurut ke mana saja yang dikehendakinya,

arabic: وَٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ
transliteration: Wash Shayaateena kulla bannaaa'inw wa ghawwaas

translations.en.sahih: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver
translations.en.pickthall: And the unruly, every builder and diver (made We subservient),
translations.en.yusufali: As also the evil ones, (including) every kind of builder and diver,-
translations.id.indonesian: dan (Kami tundukkan pula kepadanya) syaitan-syaitan semuanya ahli bangunan dan penyelam,

arabic: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
transliteration: Wa aakhareena muqarraneena fil asfaad

translations.en.sahih: And others bound together in shackles.
translations.en.pickthall: And others linked together in chains,
translations.en.yusufali: As also others bound together in fetters.
translations.id.indonesian: dan syaitan yang lain yang terikat dalam belenggu.

arabic: هَـٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
transliteration: Haazaa 'ataaa'unaa famnun aw amsik bighairi hisaab

translations.en.sahih: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
translations.en.pickthall: (Saying): This is Our gift, so bestow thou, or withhold, without reckoning.
translations.en.yusufali: "Such are Our Bounties: whether thou bestow them (on others) or withhold them, no account will be asked."
translations.id.indonesian: Inilah anugerah Kami; maka berikanlah (kepada orang lain) atau tahanlah (untuk dirimu sendiri) dengan tiada pertanggungan jawab.

arabic: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
transliteration: Wa inna lahoo 'indanaa lazulfaa wa husna ma-aab

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! he hath favour with Us, and a happy journey's end.
translations.en.yusufali: And he enjoyed, indeed, a Near Approach to Us, and a beautiful Place of (Final) Return.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya dia mempunyai kedudukan yang dekat pada sisi Kami dan tempat kembali yang baik.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ
transliteration: Wazkur 'abdanaaa Ayyoob; iz naada Rabbahooo annee massaniyash Shaitaanu binus binw wa 'azaab

translations.en.sahih: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."
translations.en.pickthall: And make mention (O Muhammad) of Our bondman Job, when he cried unto his Lord (saying): Lo! the devil doth afflict me with distress and torment.
translations.en.yusufali: Commemorate Our Servant Job. Behold he cried to his Lord: "The Evil One has afflicted me with distress and suffering!"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan ingatlah akan hamba Kami Ayyub ketika ia menyeru Tuhan-nya: "Sesungguhnya aku diganggu syaitan dengan kepayahan dan siksaan".

arabic: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ
transliteration: Urkud birijlika haaza mughtasalum baaridunw wa sharaab

translations.en.sahih: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink."
translations.en.pickthall: (And it was said unto him): Strike the ground with thy foot. This (spring) is a cool bath and a refreshing drink.
translations.en.yusufali: (The command was given:) "Strike with thy foot: here is (water) wherein to wash, cool and refreshing, and (water) to drink."
translations.id.indonesian: (Allah berfirman): "Hantamkanlah kakimu; inilah air yang sejuk untuk mandi dan untuk minum".

arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
transliteration: Wa wahabnaa lahoo ahlahoo wa mislahum ma'ahum rahmatam minna wa zikraa li ulil albaab

translations.en.sahih: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.
translations.en.pickthall: And We bestowed on him (again) his household and therewith the like thereof, a mercy from Us, and a memorial for men of understanding.
translations.en.yusufali: And We gave him (back) his people, and doubled their number,- as a Grace from Ourselves, and a thing for commemoration, for all who have Understanding.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami anugerahi dia (dengan mengumpulkan kembali) keluarganya dan (Kami tambahkan) kepada mereka sebanyak mereka pula sebagai rahmat dari Kami dan pelajaran bagi orang-orang yang mempunyai fikiran.

arabic: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَـٰهُ صَابِرًا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
transliteration: Wa khuz biyadika dighsan fadrib bihee wa laa tahnas, innaa wajadnaahu saabiraa; ni'mal 'abd; innahooo awwaab

translations.en.sahih: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].
translations.en.pickthall: And (it was said unto him): Take in thine hand a branch and smite therewith, and break not thine oath. Lo! We found him steadfast, how excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (to his Lord).
translations.en.yusufali: "And take in thy hand a little grass, and strike therewith: and break not (thy oath)." Truly We found him full of patience and constancy. How excellent in Our service! ever did he turn (to Us)!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan ambillah dengan tanganmu seikat (rumput), maka pukullah dengan itu dan janganlah kamu melanggar sumpah. Sesungguhnya Kami dapati dia (Ayyub) seorang yang sabar. Dialah sebaik-baik hamba. Sesungguhnya dia amat taat (kepada Tuhan-nya).

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَـٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ
transliteration: Wazkur 'ibaadanaaa Ibraaheema wa Is-haaqa wa Ya'qooba ulil-aydee walabsaar

translations.en.sahih: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
translations.en.pickthall: And make mention of Our bondmen, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, men of parts and vision.
translations.en.yusufali: And commemorate Our Servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, possessors of Power and Vision.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan ingatlah hamba-hamba Kami: Ibrahim, Ishaq dan Ya'qub yang mempunyai perbuatan-perbuatan yang besar dan ilmu-ilmu yang tinggi.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَـٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ
transliteration: Innaaa akhlasnaahum bi khaalisatin zikrad daar

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We purified them with a pure thought, remembrance of the Home (of the Hereafter).
translations.en.yusufali: Verily We did choose them for a special (purpose)- proclaiming the Message of the Hereafter.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami telah mensucikan mereka dengan (menganugerahkan kepada mereka) akhlak yang tinggi yaitu selalu mengingatkan (manusia) kepada negeri akhirat.

arabic: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
transliteration: Wa innahum 'indanaa laminal mustafainal akhyaar

translations.en.sahih: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! in Our sight they are verily of the elect, the excellent.
translations.en.yusufali: They were, in Our sight, truly, of the company of the Elect and the Good.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya mereka pada sisi Kami benar-benar termasuk orang-orang pilihan yang paling baik.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
transliteration: Wazkur Ismaa'eela wal Yasa'a wa Zal-Kifli wa kullum minal akhyaar

translations.en.sahih: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
translations.en.pickthall: And make mention of Ishmael and Elisha and Dhu'l-Kifl. All are of the chosen.
translations.en.yusufali: And commemorate Isma'il, Elisha, and Zul-Kifl: Each of them was of the Company of the Good.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan ingatlah akan Ismail, Ilyasa' dan Zulkifli. Semuanya termasuk orang-orang yang paling baik.

arabic: هَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
transliteration: Haazaa zikr; wa inna lilmuttaqeena lahusna ma aab

translations.en.sahih: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return
translations.en.pickthall: This is a reminder. And lo! for those who ward off (evil) is a happy journey's end,
translations.en.yusufali: This is a Message (of admonition): and verily, for the righteous, is a beautiful Place of (Final) Return,-
translations.id.indonesian: Ini adalah kehormatan (bagi mereka). Dan sesungguhnya bagi orang-orang yang bertakwa benar-benar (disediakan) tempat kembali yang baik,

arabic: جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ
transliteration: Jannaati 'adnim mufat tahatal lahumul abwaab

translations.en.sahih: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
translations.en.pickthall: Gardens of Eden, whereof the gates are opened for them,
translations.en.yusufali: Gardens of Eternity, whose doors will (ever) be open to them;
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) surga 'Adn yang pintu-pintunya terbuka bagi mereka,

arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ
transliteration: Muttaki'eena feehaa yad'oona feehaa bifaakihatin kaseeratinw wa sharaab

translations.en.sahih: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
translations.en.pickthall: Wherein, reclining, they call for plenteous fruit and cool drink (that is) therein.
translations.en.yusufali: Therein will they recline (at ease): Therein can they call (at pleasure) for fruit in abundance, and (delicious) drink;
translations.id.indonesian: di dalamnya mereka bertelekan (diatas dipan-dipan) sambil meminta buah-buahan yang banyak dan minuman di surga itu.

arabic: ۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
transliteration: Wa 'indahum qaasiraatut tarfi atraab

translations.en.sahih: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.
translations.en.pickthall: And with them are those of modest gaze, companions.
translations.en.yusufali: And beside them will be chaste women restraining their glances, (companions) of equal age.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan pada sisi mereka (ada bidadari-bidadari) yang tidak liar pandangannya dan sebaya umurnya.

arabic: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
transliteration: Haaza maa too'odoona li Yawmil Hisaab

translations.en.sahih: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
translations.en.pickthall: This it is that ye are promised for the Day of Reckoning.
translations.en.yusufali: Such is the Promise made, to you for the Day of Account!
translations.id.indonesian: Inilah apa yang dijanjikan kepadamu pada hari berhisab.

arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
transliteration: Inna haazaa larizqunaa maa lahoo min nafaad

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! this in truth is Our provision, which will never waste away.
translations.en.yusufali: Truly such will be Our Bounty (to you); it will never fail;-
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya ini adalah benar-benar rezeki dari Kami yang tiada habis-habisnya.

arabic: هَـٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّـٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍ
transliteration: Haazaa; wa inna littaagheena lasharra ma-aab

translations.en.sahih: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
translations.en.pickthall: This (is for the righteous). And lo! for the transgressors there with be an evil journey's end,
translations.en.yusufali: Yea, such! but - for the wrong-doers will be an evil place of (Final) Return!-
translations.id.indonesian: Beginilah (keadaan mereka). Dan sesungguhnya bagi orang-orang yang durhaka benar-benar (disediakan) tempat kembali yang buruk,

arabic: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
transliteration: Jahannama yaslawnahaa fai'sal mihaad

translations.en.sahih: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
translations.en.pickthall: Hell, where they will burn, an evil resting-place.
translations.en.yusufali: Hell!- they will burn therein, - an evil bed (indeed, to lie on)!-
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) neraka Jahannam, yang mereka masuk ke dalamnya; maka amat buruklah Jahannam itu sebagai tempat tinggal.

arabic: هَـٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ
transliteration: Haazaa falyazooqoohu hameemunw wa ghassaaq

translations.en.sahih: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
translations.en.pickthall: Here is a boiling and an ice-cold draught, so let them taste it,
translations.en.yusufali: Yea, such! - then shall they taste it,- a boiling fluid, and a fluid dark, murky, intensely cold!-
translations.id.indonesian: Inilah (azab neraka), biarlah mereka merasakannya, (minuman mereka) air yang sangat panas dan air yang sangat dingin.

arabic: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ
transliteration: Wa aakharu min shak liheee azwaaj

translations.en.sahih: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
translations.en.pickthall: And other (torment) of the kind in pairs (the two extremes)!
translations.en.yusufali: And other Penalties of a similar kind, to match them!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan azab yang lain yang serupa itu berbagai macam.

arabic: هَـٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ
transliteration: Haazaa fawjum muqtahimum ma'akum laa marhabam bihim; innahum saalun Naar

translations.en.sahih: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."
translations.en.pickthall: Here is an army rushing blindly with you. (Those who are already in the Fire say): No word of welcome for them. Lo! they will roast at the Fire.
translations.en.yusufali: Here is a troop rushing headlong with you! No welcome for them! truly, they shall burn in the Fire!
translations.id.indonesian: (Dikatakan kepada mereka): "Ini adalah suatu rombongan (pengikut-pengikutmu) yang masuk berdesak-desak bersama kamu (ke neraka)". (Berkata pemimpin-pemimpin mereka yang durhaka): "Tiadalah ucapan selamat datang kepada mereka karena sesungguhnya mereka akan masuk neraka".

arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
transliteration: Qaaloo bal antum laa marhabam bikum; antum qaddamtumoohu lanaa fabi'sal qaraar

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
translations.en.pickthall: They say: Nay, but you (misleaders), for you there is no word of welcome. Ye prepared this for us (by your misleading). Now hapless is the plight.
translations.en.yusufali: (The followers shall cry to the misleaders:) "Nay, ye (too)! No welcome for you! It is ye who have brought this upon us! Now evil is (this) place to stay in!"
translations.id.indonesian: Pengikut-pengikut mereka menjawab: "Sebenarnya kamulah. Tiada ucapan selamat datang bagimu, karena kamulah yang menjerumuskan kami ke dalam azab, maka amat buruklah Jahannam itu sebagai tempat menetap".

arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِى ٱلنَّارِ
transliteration: Qaaloo Rabbanaa man qaddama lanaa haaza fazidhu 'azaaban di'fan fin Naar

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."
translations.en.pickthall: They say: Our Lord! Whoever did prepare this for us, oh, give him double portion of the Fire!
translations.en.yusufali: They will say: "Our Lord! whoever brought this upon us,- Add to him a double Penalty in the Fire!"
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata (lagi): "Ya Tuhan kami; barang siapa yang menjerumuskan kami ke dalam azab ini maka tambahkanlah azab kepadanya dengan berlipat ganda di dalam neraka".

arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ
transliteration: Wa qaaloo ma lanaa laa naraa rijaalan kunnaa na'udduhum minal ashraar

translations.en.sahih: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?
translations.en.pickthall: And they say: What aileth us that we behold not men whom we were wont to count among the wicked?
translations.en.yusufali: And they will say: "What has happened to us that we see not men whom we used to number among the bad ones?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan (orang-orang durhaka) berkata: "Mengapa kami tidak melihat orang-orang yang dahulu (di dunia) kami anggap sebagai orang-orang yang jahat (hina).

arabic: أَتَّخَذْنَـٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ
transliteration: Attakhaznaahum sikh riyyan am zaaghat 'anhumul absaar

translations.en.sahih: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
translations.en.pickthall: Did we take them (wrongly) for a laughing-stock, or have our eyes missed them?
translations.en.yusufali: "Did we treat them (as such) in ridicule, or have (our) eyes failed to perceive them?"
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah kami dahulu menjadikan mereka olok-olokan, ataukah karena mata kami tidak melihat mereka?"

arabic: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ
transliteration: Inna zaalika lahaqqun takhaasumu Ahlin Naar

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, that is truth - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! that is very truth: the wrangling of the dwellers in the Fire.
translations.en.yusufali: Truly that is just and fitting,- the mutual recriminations of the People of the Fire!
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya yang demikian itu pasti terjadi, (yaitu) pertengkaran penghuni neraka.

arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
transliteration: Qul innamaaa ana munzirunw wa maa min ilaahim illal laahul Waahidul Qahhaar

translations.en.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing.
translations.en.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I am only a warner, and there is no Allah save Allah, the One, the Absolute,
translations.en.yusufali: Say: "Truly am I a Warner: no god is there but the one Allah, Supreme and Irresistible,-
translations.id.indonesian: Katakanlah (ya Muhammad): "Sesungguhnya aku hanya seorang pemberi peringatan, dan sekali-kali tidak ada Tuhan selain Allah Yang Maha Esa dan Maha Mengalahkan.

arabic: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرُ
transliteration: Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumal 'Azeezul Ghaffaar

translations.en.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."
translations.en.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Mighty, the Pardoning.
translations.en.yusufali: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all between,- Exalted in Might, able to enforce His Will, forgiving again and again."
translations.id.indonesian: Tuhan langit dan bumi dan apa yang ada di antara keduanya Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Pengampun.

arabic: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ
transliteration: Qul huwa naba'un 'azeem

translations.en.sahih: Say, "It is great news
translations.en.pickthall: Say: It is tremendous tidings
translations.en.yusufali: Say: "That is a Message Supreme (above all),-
translations.id.indonesian: Katakanlah: "Berita itu adalah berita yang besar,

arabic: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
transliteration: Antum 'anhu mu'ridoon

translations.en.sahih: From which you turn away.
translations.en.pickthall: Whence ye turn away!
translations.en.yusufali: "From which ye do turn away!
translations.id.indonesian: yang kamu berpaling daripadanya.

arabic: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
transliteration: Maa kaana liya min 'ilmim bilmala il a'laaa iz yakhtasimoon

translations.en.sahih: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].
translations.en.pickthall: I had no knowledge of the Highest Chiefs when they disputed;
translations.en.yusufali: "No knowledge have I of the Chiefs on high, when they discuss (matters) among themselves.
translations.id.indonesian: Aku tiada mempunyai pengetahuan sedikitpun tentang al mala'ul a'la (malaikat) itu ketika mereka berbantah-bantahan.

arabic: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
transliteration: Iny-yoohaaa ilaiya illaaa annnamaaa ana nazeerum mubeen

translations.en.sahih: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."
translations.en.pickthall: It is revealed unto me only that I may be a plain warner.
translations.en.yusufali: 'Only this has been revealed to me: that I am to give warning plainly and publicly."
translations.id.indonesian: Tidak diwahyukan kepadaku, melainkan bahwa sesungguhnya aku hanyalah seorang pemberi peringatan yang nyata".

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ
transliteration: Iz qaala Rabbuka lilmalaaa'ikati innee khaaliqum basharam min teen

translations.en.sahih: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
translations.en.pickthall: When thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to create a mortal out of mire,
translations.en.yusufali: Behold, thy Lord said to the angels: "I am about to create man from clay:
translations.id.indonesian: (Ingatlah) ketika Tuhanmu berfirman kepada malaikat: "Sesungguhnya Aku akan menciptakan manusia dari tanah".

arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ
transliteration: Fa-iza sawwaituhoo wa nafakhtu feehi mir roohee faqa'oo lahoo saajideen

translations.en.sahih: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
translations.en.pickthall: And when I have fashioned him and breathed into him of My Spirit, then fall down before him prostrate,
translations.en.yusufali: "When I have fashioned him (in due proportion) and breathed into him of My spirit, fall ye down in obeisance unto him."
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apabila telah Kusempurnakan kejadiannya dan Kutiupkan kepadanya roh (ciptaan)Ku; maka hendaklah kamu tersungkur dengan bersujud kepadanya".

arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
transliteration: Fasajadal malaaa'ikatu kulluhum ajma'oon

translations.en.sahih: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely.
translations.en.pickthall: The angels fell down prostrate, every one,
translations.en.yusufali: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together:
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu seluruh malaikat-malaikat itu bersujud semuanya,

arabic: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
transliteration: Illaaa Iblees; istakbara wa kaana minal kaafireen

translations.en.sahih: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
translations.en.pickthall: Saving Iblis; he was scornful and became one of the disbelievers.
translations.en.yusufali: Not so Iblis: he was haughty, and became one of those who reject Faith.
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali iblis; dia menyombongkan diri dan adalah dia termasuk orang-orang yang kafir.

arabic: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ
transliteration: Qaala yaaa Ibleesu maa man'aka an tasjuda limaa khalaqtu biyadai; astakbarta am kunta min 'aaleen

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
translations.en.pickthall: He said: O Iblis! What hindereth thee from falling prostrate before that which I have created with both My hands? Art thou too proud or art thou of the high exalted?
translations.en.yusufali: (Allah) said: "O Iblis! What prevents thee from prostrating thyself to one whom I have created with my hands? Art thou haughty? Or art thou one of the high (and mighty) ones?"
translations.id.indonesian: Allah berfirman: "Hai iblis, apakah yang menghalangi kamu sujud kepada yang telah Ku-ciptakan dengan kedua tangan-Ku. Apakah kamu menyombongkan diri ataukah kamu (merasa) termasuk orang-orang yang (lebih) tinggi?".

arabic: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍ
transliteration: Qaala ana khairum minah; khalaqtanee min naarinw wa khalaqtahoo min teen

translations.en.sahih: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: I am better than him. Thou createdst me of fire, whilst him Thou didst create of clay.
translations.en.yusufali: (Iblis) said: "I am better than he: thou createdst me from fire, and him thou createdst from clay."
translations.id.indonesian: Iblis berkata: "Aku lebih baik daripadanya, karena Engkau ciptakan aku dari api, sedangkan dia Engkau ciptakan dari tanah".

arabic: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
transliteration: Qaala fakhruj minhaa fainnaka rajeem

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "Then get out of Paradise, for indeed, you are expelled.
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Go forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast,
translations.en.yusufali: (Allah) said: "Then get thee out from here: for thou art rejected, accursed.
translations.id.indonesian: Allah berfirman: "Maka keluarlah kamu dari surga; sesungguhnya kamu adalah orang yang terkutuk,

arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
transliteration: Wa inna 'alaika la'nateee ilaa Yawmid Deen

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! My curse is on thee till the Day of Judgment.
translations.en.yusufali: "And My curse shall be on thee till the Day of Judgment."
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya kutukan-Ku tetap atasmu sampai hari pembalasan".

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
transliteration: Qaala Rabbi fa anzirneee ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon

translations.en.sahih: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised.
translations.en.yusufali: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! Give me then respite till the Day the (dead) are raised."
translations.id.indonesian: Iblis berkata: "Ya Tuhanku, beri tangguhlah aku sampai hari mereka dibangkitkan".

arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
transliteration: Qaala fa innaka minal munzareen

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Lo! thou art of those reprieved
translations.en.yusufali: (Allah) said: "Respite then is granted thee-
translations.id.indonesian: Allah berfirman: "Sesungguhnya kamu termasuk orang-orang yang diberi tangguh,

arabic: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
transliteration: Ilaa Yawmil waqtil ma'loom

translations.en.sahih: Until the Day of the time well-known."
translations.en.pickthall: Until the day of the time appointed.
translations.en.yusufali: "Till the Day of the Time Appointed."
translations.id.indonesian: sampai kepada hari yang telah ditentukan waktunya (hari Kiamat)".

arabic: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
transliteration: Qaala fabi'izzatika la ughwiyannahum ajma'een

translations.en.sahih: [Iblees] said, "By your might, I will surely mislead them all
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Then, by Thy might, I surely will beguile them every one,
translations.en.yusufali: (Iblis) said: "Then, by Thy power, I will put them all in the wrong,-
translations.id.indonesian: Iblis menjawab: "Demi kekuasaan Engkau aku akan menyesatkan mereka semuanya,

arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
transliteration: Illaa 'ibaadaka minhumul mukhlaseen

translations.en.sahih: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
translations.en.pickthall: Save Thy single-minded slaves among them.
translations.en.yusufali: "Except Thy Servants amongst them, sincere and purified (by Thy Grace)."
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali hamba-hamba-Mu yang mukhlis di antara mereka.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
transliteration: Qaala falhaqq, walhaqqa aqool

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -
translations.en.pickthall: He said: The Truth is, and the Truth I speak,
translations.en.yusufali: (Allah) said: "Then it is just and fitting- and I say what is just and fitting-
translations.id.indonesian: Allah berfirman: "Maka yang benar (adalah sumpah-Ku) dan hanya kebenaran itulah yang Ku-katakan".

arabic: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
transliteration: La amla'annna Jahannama minka wa mimman tabi'aka minhum ajma'een

translations.en.sahih: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
translations.en.pickthall: That I shall fill hell with thee and with such of them as follow thee, together.
translations.en.yusufali: "That I will certainly fill Hell with thee and those that follow thee,- every one."
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Aku pasti akan memenuhi neraka Jahannam dengan jenis kamu dan dengan orang-orang yang mengikuti kamu di antara mereka kesemuanya.

arabic: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
transliteration: Qul maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrinw wa maaa ana minal mutakallifeen

translations.en.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for the Qur'an any payment, and I am not of the pretentious
translations.en.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I ask of you no fee for this, and I am no simulating.
translations.en.yusufali: Say: "No reward do I ask of you for this (Qur'an), nor am I a pretender.
translations.id.indonesian: Katakanlah (hai Muhammad): "Aku tidak meminta upah sedikitpun padamu atas dakwahku dan bukanlah aku termasuk orang-orang yang mengada-adakan.

arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
transliteration: In huwa illaa zikrul lil'aalameen

translations.en.sahih: It is but a reminder to the worlds.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! it is naught else than a reminder for all peoples
translations.en.yusufali: "This is no less than a Message to (all) the Worlds.
translations.id.indonesian: Al Quran ini tidak lain hanyalah peringatan bagi semesta alam.

arabic: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ
transliteration: Wa lata'lamunna naba ahoo ba'da heen

translations.en.sahih: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
translations.en.pickthall: And ye will come in time to know the truth thereof.
translations.en.yusufali: "And ye shall certainly know the truth of it (all) after a while."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya kamu akan mengetahui (kebenaran) berita Al Quran setelah beberapa waktu lagi.
